meta.name: anomaly-detection
meta.description: Identify unusual patterns, outliers, and anomalies in data using statistical methods, isolation forests, and autoencoders for fraud detection and quality monitoring

copy.tagline: 从数据中自动发现异常模式和离群点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在海量数据中快速定位异常记录
copy.tagline_en: Automatically detect unusual patterns and outliers in data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly spot anomalies in large datasets

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可对数据使用统计方法、孤立森林、自编码器等算法，识别异常模式、离群点和异常值，用于欺诈检测和质量监控。
howto.when: 当你提供数据集，并要求进行异常检测、离群点识别或欺诈监控时触发。

say.text: 帮我检测这组交易数据中的异常记录。
say.note: Claude 将调用统计方法识别异常。

say.text: 用孤立森林找出这些传感器读数的离群点。
对这批客户行为数据进行异常检测。
say.note: Claude 将选择合适方法并给出结果。

howto.what_en: Claude can detect unusual patterns, outliers, and anomalies in data using statistical methods, isolation forests, and autoencoders for fraud detection and quality monitoring.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a dataset and request anomaly detection, outlier identification, or fraud monitoring.

say_en.text: Find anomalous records in this transaction data.
Detect outliers in these sensor readings using Isolation Forest.
say_en.note: Claude runs the Isolation Forest algorithm.

say_en.text: Perform anomaly detection on this customer behavior data.
say_en.note: Claude selects a suitable method and returns results.
